docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY KNOP, GALINA AS TO DEFENDANT PONTIER, LENA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-05-2006 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
